statement: Independent education and SME critic approval was not required and was not performed for these bytes under the captain-approved finite review-evidence exception. This record is implementation-owner evidence only.
checks: Scope: presentation-only migration of a legacy teal page to the root DESIGN.md contract (violet tokens, topic bar with closed Objectives disclosure holding the catalog objective text, activity timeline with reversible Previous/Next and back links, Your task and Activity checks peers, progressive hints on the two practice tasks, print and responsive rules). The page opts in to data-pep-responsive and data-pep-guidance-contract.

Teaching meaning preserved: an automated old-versus-new comparison against main 0db2ed16 (every visible text chunk, data-static-alt/aria-label/value attributes and every string literal of the lesson TOPIC script) found every teaching sentence, option label, per-option explanation, feedback and verdict string, simulator command, output and error message, honest simulation notice, recap and sources disclosure present. The only removed strings are the legacy header meta line, What you'll be able to do heading, Activities done counter, Restart description, All activities finished line and Current teaching/Current task/Your turn region labels.

Supported execution and scoring unchanged: the lesson TOPIC script (steps, options, answers, explanations, simulator commands, outputs and goal checks) is carried verbatim from main; only the surrounding runtime (shared jb-engine@1 built from authoring/evidence/java-foundations/java-basics/page-build), markup and CSS changed. Predictions stay unscored; the graded apply keeps confidence before feedback, one retry in a second representation, then reveal and lock; confidence is never scored; credit is issued once per activity and completion needs all four activities. Restart now clears only the current activity and restores its own model state.

Disclosed behaviour change: the legacy Continue/recap step is replaced by Previous/Next activity buttons, a timeline and back links; the recap shows after the fourth activity completes. Progress text now reads Activity N of 4 with X of 4 done. Timing was re-measured with the frozen estimator and recorded in topic.json.

Non-browser proof on these bytes, 2026-11-09: node gates T01-T05, T07, T14, T15 (live source receipts refetched and rebound), T16, T17, T19, T20 and T24 passed; a jsdom replay of every qa-paths.json route (success, wrong-first, wrong-twice, keyboard, simulator edges, restart-with-credit and guidance navigation/restart invariants) passed, apart from a jsdom-only re-check of an already-selected disabled radio that Playwright treats as a no-op.
Browser gates T08-T13 and T18 have not yet run on these bytes because the shared Chromium window was owned by another validator; they remain required before merge.

Companions: artifact.gift and video-artifact.md are byte-identical to main 0db2ed16 and were not changed or re-reviewed; they are bound here because this record replaces per-file critic coverage for the topic.

Answer safety and privacy: no answer key, rubric, hidden test or secret was added; qa-paths.json uses short non-secret strings; formative option keys remain readable in page source as on every offline formative page. No telemetry, external requests or font files.
Not run: no real JDK, Maven, IDE or shell execution; no independent education or SME critic review of these bytes.
